verdicts.quote: Reminders have three scheduled offsets from the due date. … The offsets are 1, 7, and 14 calendar days after the due date, including weekends and holidays.

Zero balances, credit balances, and unavailable or indeterminate balances fail this check. … Paid or otherwise fully settled, voided or canceled, written-off, deleted, and superseded invoices produce zero new submissions … an unresolved dispute produces zero submissions
verdicts.missing: Whether an active payment plan suspends reminders when a positive balance remains and no separate collection hold is recorded.

verdicts.quote: If a partial payment reduces the outstanding amount from 100 USD to 40 USD before initiation, the attempted message states 40 USD.
Missing, malformed, ambiguous, suppressed following a known permanent delivery failure, and explicitly opted-out destinations each produce zero new submissions.
verdicts.missing: Whether a customer-wide do-not-contact or pause applies across billing addresses, and whether a marketing unsubscribe also suppresses billing reminders.

verdicts.quote: Overlapping runs, repeated triggers, redeployment, account toggles, due-date edits, retries, and recipient changes cannot produce a second accepted submission for the same billing account, invoice, and offset.

For each attempt, a payment, state change, account pause, due-date edit, suppression or opt-out change, or recipient correction effective before submission initiation is reflected in the eligibility check.

A temporary delivery outage permits automatic retry. … The earliest automatic retry starts 15 minutes after temporary nonacceptance. … A scheduled window permits a maximum of three submission attempts. … the window shows retry exhausted.
verdicts.missing: Whether repeated failures trigger an alert or handoff to a person, and who receives it.

verdicts.quote: A provider-specified retry time is honored. The selected service and its per-second limit, rolling or daily quota, and submission concurrency limit are unconfirmed.
verdicts.missing: Which provider limits apply and how to pace a large batch within them before throttling occurs.
